sentences.text: Opposite Party :- The State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Rajendra Prasad Lodhi,Vayu Nandan Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The FIR in question was lodged alleging that the applicant had developed physical relation for a period of two years on false pretext of marriage.
Similar allegations were also made in the statement under Section 161 of Cr.P.C.
There are huge variance in the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.
The mother of the victim also stated that there was a promise of marriage by the accused.
The age of the victim as per Aadhar is 22 years and as per the medical report, the age of the victim is at around 16 to 17 years.

With regard to the determination of the age of the victim, the applicant places reliance of Pramod Suryabhan Pawar vs The State Of Maharashtra, Criminal Appeal No. 1165 of Mithun vs The State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51407614/
1 2019 arsing out of SLP (Crl) No.2712 of 2019, decided on 21.08.2019.
3. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.
4. Considering the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Pramod Suryabhan Pawar (Supra) coupled with the fact that as per the victim herself, physical relation was made on the false pretext of marriage, the applicant is in custody since 10.12.2022, there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

sentences.text: 5. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Mithun be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.730 of 2022, under Section 376 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Nanpara, District Bahraich on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable local sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
